title: Extension context menu items with contextMenus
when: A browser extension should add entries to the browser's right click menu for selected text, links, images or the whole page.
prompt:
Goal: Menu items created once at install, shown only in fitting contexts and handled by a top level listener in the service worker.
Steps:
1. Add "contextMenus" to permissions, plus "activeTab" and "scripting" if an item acts on the page.
2. In chrome.runtime.onInstalled: chrome.contextMenus.removeAll(), then create items with fixed ids, for example { id: "lookup", title: "Look up \"%s\"", contexts: ["selection"] }.
3. Narrow where items show with documentUrlPatterns or targetUrlPatterns.
4. Several items go under one parent ({ id: "root", title: "My tool" } and parentId: "root").
5. chrome.contextMenus.onClicked.addListener((info, tab) => ...) at top level; switch on info.menuItemId and read info.selectionText, info.linkUrl, info.srcUrl or info.pageUrl.
6. Validate those values: trim, cap length, parse links with new URL.
7. Page work: chrome.scripting.executeScript({ target: { tabId: tab.id }, func, args: [text] }); tab may be undefined in some contexts, so check it.
Quality bar:
- Items appear only where they make sense.
- No duplicate id errors after reloads or updates.
Pitfalls:
- Creating items on every worker start instead of onInstalled.
- An onclick property in create(), unsupported in Manifest V3 workers.
- Long selections pasted straight into a URL.
Verify:
- [ ] contextMenus permission declared.
- [ ] Items created in onInstalled with ids.
- [ ] onClicked registered at top level.
- [ ] Selection and link values validated.
Output: menus.js imported by background.js, plus the manifest permissions.

examples.input: add a right click option to search the selected text in my app
examples.output: menus.js creating items in onInstalled with ids and contexts, top level onClicked switch, selection validated, executeScript for page work
